purpose.domain_detail: Event/conference attendee management system for a camping event called 'BarnCamp'
purpose.summary: BAMS (BarnCamp Attendee Management System) is an interactive terminal-based application for managing attendees at a camping event called BarnCamp. It supports listing, adding, editing, and searching attendees stored in an indexed file, and displays statistics such as people on-site, arriving, kids counts, and payment status. The program uses a full-screen CRT interface with multiple screens (Home, Edit, List, Search, View).

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with multiple full-screen definitions
Table with OCCURS DEPENDING ON and multiple ASCENDING KEY clauses
SORT on table with COLLATING SEQUENCE
COPY with REPLACING for record definitions
88-level condition names with WHEN SET TO FALSE
